subject.title: [codex] Preserve request SecretRef markers in models.json

question: Should nested provider request SecretRefs use the existing reserved marker-string contract in generated `models.json`, with those markers removed at every runtime transport boundary?
rationale: This changes how persisted provider request credentials are represented and when marker-shaped values are discarded, so accepting the permanent credential and compatibility boundary requires owner intent rather than an automated repair verdict.

options.title: Accept and repair this boundary
options.body: Keep the marker projection and transport stripping design, fix the audit sensitivity defect, rebase, and require fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Use separate credential metadata
options.body: Redesign generated catalogs so credential provenance is represented outside user-visible request values, avoiding reserved sentinel-string collisions.

options.title: Pause nested request persistence
options.body: Close or defer this PR until the broader security roadmap establishes a different generated-catalog credential architecture.

recommendation.title: Accept and repair this boundary
recommendation.body: Keep the marker projection and transport stripping design, fix the audit sensitivity defect, rebase, and require fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history most directly owns SecretRef audits and generated-model credential detection.
